fact: A furnished criminal analysis bureau with computer equipment for judicial police officers was handed to the Congolese authorities on 28 February 2024, its head calling it the end of manual processing of criminal data and the start of software-based analysis, built through cooperation between the PNC, UNDP, MONUSCO's police component and the Korean National Police Agency under the joint police reform support programme.
title: La Police judiciaire dotée d’un nouveau bâtiment abritant le bureau d’analyse criminelle
